title: Robert Low memo on Condon study

tellings.quote: There's a famous letter written by the deputy datan, Robert Low, who wrote a memo

plain: Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, points to a memo from 1966 or 1967 written by a man named Robert Low. Low was a senior figure in the Condon study, a UFO study run at the University of Colorado in those years. Salas calls it "a famous letter" from someone he describes as a deputy on the study. He cites the memo as telling evidence about how the study was run, but in this passage he does not say what it contains.
